_purpose: A Louis-requested priority detour for the Bible Note Writer Agent, checked BEFORE data/bible-notes-style-redo-remaining.json and before normal canonical-order forward progress. When this file's `remaining` array is non-empty, the agent's next chapter is the FIRST entry in it, written as a brand new chapter through the normal new-chapter pipeline (fetch real KJV text, write lib/<book><ChapterWord>Source.ts, wire it into lib/bibleReaderStudyNotes.ts, verify with the style checker/parser check/tsc, log it, commit, push). Once that chapter is verified and pushed, pop its entry from the front of `remaining` as part of the same commit. Once this array is empty, the agent falls back to the style-redo backlog, then to normal canonical-order forward progress. No extra bookkeeping is needed to 'resume where it left off': normal forward progress always scans from Genesis 1 for the first chapter with no wired-in file, and Proverbs sits much later in canonical order (after Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther, Job, and Psalms), so that scan will land back on the chapter right after wherever forward progress actually stood before this detour (2 Chronicles 10 as of 2026-08-16) without skipping anything. When forward progress later reaches Proverbs naturally in canonical order, the chapters written here will already exist and simply be skipped over as already done.
requestedBy: Louis, live chat request on 2026-08-16: skip ahead and write all of Proverbs now, then resume normal forward progress where it left off.
